description: You are the CRM systems administrator at LumiGlow, a skincare and beauty brand. Add a custom customer attribute with code 'skin_concern', label 'Primary Skin Concern', input type Dropdown, required, visible on storefront, sort order 10, used in Customer Registration and Customer Account Edit forms. Add exactly 5 dropdown options in this order: 'Acne & Blemishes', 'Anti-Aging', 'Hyperpigmentation', 'Dryness & Dehydration', 'Sensitivity'. Save the attribute. If not logged in, use admin/Admin1234!.
